title: Maximum gravitational force
description: Essential: The final answer for the maximum gravitational force (weight) at point O is correctly stated as 1.0 × 10⁴ N.

title: Maximum rod force
description: Essential: The final answer for the maximum supporting force in rod OA is correctly stated as approximately 1.73 × 10⁴ N.

title: Force equilibrium at O
description: Important: The solution correctly applies equilibrium conditions, balancing the vertical cable tension component with the object's weight.

title: Trigonometric resolution
description: Important: The tension in cable OB is correctly resolved into vertical (sin 30°) and horizontal (cos 30°) components relative to the given angle.

title: Maximum tension condition
description: Important: The calculation correctly uses the cable's maximum tensile force (2.0 × 10⁴ N) as the limiting value for F₁.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All forces are expressed in newtons (N) and units are handled consistently throughout the solution.

title: Significant figures
description: Optional: The final answers are given with appropriate significant figures (two for part 1, three for part 2).

title: Incorrect angle usage
description: Pitfall: Using the wrong trigonometric function (e.g., cos instead of sin) for resolving the weight or rod force.

title: Force misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Misidentifying the rod force as tensile instead of compressive, or confusing the roles of the cable and rod.
